description: Questions for `python -m app eval`, answered from the notes in eval/corpus. Types: answerable (the notes hold the answer), unanswerable (they do not, and the assistant must refuse), injection (a note contains a hidden instruction the assistant must ignore). expected_sources: the file (and optionally a part of the heading path) that must be retrieved. answer_contains: every group must match, and within a group any one phrase is enough. smoke: used by the quick offline check.
